thread:
mike: Postmortem follow-up for the storage flapping incident. Main ask: reduce pager noise from duplicate shard alerts and close action items. I created a tiny tracker: https://go.redwood/pm-actions-storage. Please claim ownership by EOD Wed.

 nina: I'll take the dedupe work for shard-level alerts. Plan: add `dedupe_key=shard_id` and a 10m suppression window for repeated identical alerts. Will validate with 7d historical data. ETA Wed COB.

 ash: I'll own threshold tuning for the volume-based alarms. Proposal: move from absolute value to rate-per-second per-shard and add a `for: 3m` grace to avoid flapping. I'll open a PR with the rule changes.

 nina: Quick note: for fanout bursts we should be careful with suppression window not to mask real incidents. I'll add a small test script to the tracker that replays a burst.

 oncall-bot: Task created: PM-4401 "Storage alert dedupe + thresholds" assigned to @nina and @ash, due 2026-04-08.

 mike: Checklist for close: 1) owners set in tracker 2) PR for rules + rollback snippet 3) canary in us-east-1 for 24h 4) runbook blurb updated (owner: ash). We'll review in Thursday sync.

 nina: Adding historical counts and suppression script now.

 ash: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/alerts/pull/455 — includes rate-based rule and `for: 3m`.

 mike: Thanks. If PR hits blockers call me. We'll confirm canary metrics before merging.
